title: En CapCut, ve a la sección de IA y selecciona Seedance 2.0 Mini para generar…
content:
En CapCut, ve a la sección de IA y selecciona Seedance 2.0 Mini para generar videos dentro del editor.  
Ajusta duración, formato y calidad del video en Seedance 2.0 Mini según tu objetivo antes de generar.  
Describe la escena con un prompt claro y genera el resultado en Seedance 2.0 Mini.  
Itera probando distintos ángulos de cámara, ritmos y estilos visuales en múltiples generaciones hasta quedarte con la mejor versión.  
Parte de un único brief/resumen para generar múltiples conceptos de anuncios en lugar de apostar por una sola generación.  
Tras elegir la mejor generación, termina la pieza en CapCut añadiendo subtítulos, ajustando el ritmo, incorporando música y un CTA, y exporta sin salir de la plataforma.

en.content:
---
In CapCut, go to the AI section and select Seedance 2.0 Mini to generate videos within the editor.  
Adjust the duration, format, and quality of the video in Seedance 2.0 Mini according to your goal before generating.  
Describe the scene with a clear prompt and generate the result in Seedance 2.0 Mini.  
Iterate by testing different camera angles, rhythms, and visual styles in multiple generations until you find the best version.  
Start from a single brief/summary to generate multiple ad concepts instead of betting on just one generation.  
After choosing the best generation, finish the piece in CapCut by adding subtitles, adjusting the pace, incorporating music and a CTA, and export without leaving the platform.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Access CapCut from here: https://t.co/QRRXaLHjYo

In the AI section, select Seedance 2.0 Mini.
Then, adjust the duration, format, and quality of the video according to your goal.

All that's left is to describe the scene in the prompt and generate the result.

In a few steps, you'll have a video ready to use.

[Thread 2] Most creators don't fail because they run out of ideas.

They stop experimenting because each new generation costs credits.

With Seedance 2.0 Mini in CapCut,
I generated multiple ad concepts from a single summary instead of betting it all on one result.

That completely changed my creative workflow.

[Thread 3] What surprised me the most was this.

Being faster and more economical, I stopped worrying about wasting credits.

> I tried different camera angles.
> Different rhythms.
> New visual styles.

Instead of accepting the first result, I kept iterating until I got a video truly ready to publish.

[Thread 4] The process didn't end when the video was generated.

I chose the best version,
went directly into CapCut,
added subtitles,
adjusted the pace,
incorporated music and a CTA,
and exported everything without switching platforms.

That made the experience feel like a real production flow, not just another AI demonstration.

[Thread 5] The biggest lesson wasn't discovering that AI can create videos.

We already knew that.

The real advantage is in creating more versions, testing more ideas, iterating faster, and publishing more frequently without constantly worrying about credits.

For any creator producing content every week, that difference completely changes the way of working.

Try this: https://t.co/QRRXaLHjYo

CapCutで、AIセクションに移動し、Seedance 2.0 Miniを選択してエディター内でビデオを生成します。

シーンを明確なプロンプトで説明し、Seedance 2.0 Miniで結果を生成します。  
複数の生成で異なるカメラアングル、リズム、ビジュアルスタイルを試し、最良のバージョンを選びます。  
単一のブリーフ/要約から複数の広告コンセプトを生成し、一つの生成に賭けるのではなく、様々なアイデアを試します。

CapCutのSeedance 2.0 Miniで、
単一の要約から複数の広告コンセプトを生成し、一つの結果に全てを賭けることはありませんでした。

[スレッド3] 最も驚いたのはこれでした。

> 新しいビジュアルスタイル。

最初の結果を受け入れるのではなく、公開するのに本当に準備ができたビデオを得るまで繰り返しました。

> 다른 리듬을 시도했습니다.

음악과 CTA를 통합하고,  
플랫폼을 변경하지 않고 모든 것을 내보냈습니다.

[Thread 5] 가장 큰 교훈은 AI가 비디오를 생성할 수 있다는 것을 발견한 것이 아니었습니다.

그것은 이미 알고 있었습니다.

진정한 이점은 더 많은 버전을 만들고, 더 많은 아이디어를 시도하고, 더 빠르게 반복하고, 크레딧에 대해 끊임없이 걱정하지 않고 더 자주 게시하는 데 있습니다.

매주 콘텐츠를 제작하는 모든 창작자에게 그 차이는 작업 방식을 완전히 바꿉니다.

이것을 시도해보세요: https://t.co/QRRXaLHjYo

[Thread 1] Acesse o CapCut aqui: https://t.co/QRRXaLHjYo

Na seção de IA, selecione Seedance 2.0 Mini.  
Depois, ajuste a duração, o formato e a qualidade do vídeo de acordo com seu objetivo.

Só falta descrever a cena no prompt e gerar o resultado.

Em poucos passos, você terá um vídeo pronto para usar.

Isso mudou completamente meu fluxo de trabalho criativo.
